    Profile

    Eve is the powerhouse of Lustburg. She's a young girl who has been doing strength training for beauty and health purposes, but eventually became so strong that she's now a representative force of her kingdom. Her dream however, is to become a bride one day. It is said that she's refused all knight factions that scouted her.

    Origin: Lustburg
    Gender: Female
    Height: 161cm
    Weight: 53kg
    Birthday: Apr 4
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: Laces and ribbons
    Hobbies: Training!
    Illust: 渡り棒
    CV: 井口裕香
